title: Democratic Quality Scorecard: Universal Public Transport and Accessible Mobility Bill

dimensions.evidence: Protects Article 19(1)(d) freedom of movement and Article 14 non-discrimination for persons with disabilities.
Mandates 100% disability accessibility and 1km urban transit stop radius.
Automated impoundment and civil fines for motor vehicle trespass on NMT bicycle lanes.
Independent National Transit Authority with judicial oversight by Disability Commissioners.
Mandatory real-time open GIS publication of transit stop radius maps and accessibility audits.
Grant withholding for non-accessible fleet procurement.
13 languages, braille/screen-reader support, audio-visual transit announcements.
